name: read
description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace. `path` is relative to the workspace root.

name: ls
description: List a directory in the workspace (long format). `path` defaults to the workspace root.

name: write
description: Create or overwrite a workspace file with `content`. `path` is relative to the workspace root.

name: bash
description: Run a shell command from the workspace root. Destructive or exfiltrating commands are blocked by the sandbox.
